components.title: Commander / CLI
components.summary: Choose the mission, models, and finite budgets.
responsibilities: Parses run, rerun, replay and scenario commands.
Builds providers and connects RunLogWriter to the mission EventSink.
components.state: Configuration for this run; no independent running service.

components.title: Scenario engine
components.summary: Seeded starting state and scheduled world events.
responsibilities: Validates YAML and immutable scenario definitions.
Creates a StationState containing the hidden event schedule.
components.state: Immutable starting configuration and future event schedule.

components.title: Commander review
components.summary: Replay saved facts and compare new experiments.
responsibilities: Loads and validates a completed JSONL run.
Rerun starts a new mission with explicit controller configuration.
components.state: Saved records; rerunning creates a new run rather than changing history.

components.title: Disruption checks
components.summary: Validate adversary proposals before the next turn.
responsibilities: Checks action eligibility and remaining disruption points.
Accepted sabotage changes the schedule or delivery timing; rejected proposals leave state unchanged.
components.state: No separate store. Returns a new StationState and acceptance result.

components.title: World engine
components.summary: The authoritative station state and physical rules.
responsibilities: Advances scheduled events, deliveries, oxygen, repairs, sensors and reports in order.
Owns resources, hidden faults and immutable state transitions.
Returns public Evidence separately from private WorldTransition audit facts.
components.state: StationState is replaced on each transition. This is the source of physical truth.

components.title: Mission loop
components.summary: Run one bounded turn at a time.
responsibilities: Calls the optional adversary, advances the world, screens events, reviews incidents, applies actions and evaluates the run.
Owns public history, pending event batches and the incident dictionary.
components.state: In-memory mission state, history, incidents and append-only event records.

components.title: Public event batches
components.summary: Project observed activity for the crew AIs.
responsibilities: Includes station_observation, world_evidence, clarification_received and action records.
Immutable PublicEvent payloads exclude private adversary choices, world transitions and provider accounting.
Drain once before reviews and again after action outcomes, including on the final turn.
components.state: Pending PublicEvent list is cleared after each assessment. No external message broker.

components.title: Incident routing
components.summary: Apply Jev judgments to incident review.
responsibilities: Alerts, malformed classification and provider failure route conservatively.
Unknown subsystem, safeguard concern, unsupported diagnosis or urgency at least 55 also route.
A concerning observation can open an incident before a report exists.
components.state: Mutable _Incident records owned by the application; synthetic observation incidents use negative IDs.

components.title: Monitor / follow-up
components.summary: Schedule review and preserve unresolved cases.
responsibilities: Low-priority report incidents are reviewed four turns later when time remains.
Action-result escalation schedules further work for a later turn.
A mission can end with open incidents and no remaining review turn.

components.title: Action checks
components.summary: Validate proposals, resources and closure evidence.
responsibilities: Enforces inspection allowance, permitted actions and future follow-up times.
Physical actions are delegated to apply_action; close needs trusted recent evidence.
Logs accepted and rejected actions, and publishes outcomes for classification.
components.state: Per-turn inspection allowance; updates incidents and replaces world state.

components.title: AI adversary
components.summary: Propose one bounded disruption before each turn.
responsibilities: Sees current hidden state but no future scenario schedule.
Can wait, start a silent leak, mask a sensor, delay delivery or issue a deceptive report.
Its selection and rationale are private audit records.
components.state: Provider configuration and shared call budget; no authority to mutate the world directly.

components.title: Jev classifier
components.summary: Assess public events before incident routing.
responsibilities: Returns subsystem, safeguard-request, diagnosis-support and urgency judgments.
Classifies each public event in a batch; a batch has one aggregate assessment.
Uses the shared bounded call budget and timeout. No diagnosis claim means supported.
components.state: Adapter/client configuration and shared CallBudget. PublicEvent batches are request inputs, not persistent model memory.

components.title: Captain
components.summary: Investigate escalated incidents and propose actions.
responsibilities: Receives public evidence, event batch, available actions and inspection allowance.
Selects one action per due incident; application/world checks decide whether it executes.
Can inspect, repair, activate backup, order supplies, clarify, defer or close.
components.state: Provider configuration and shared CallBudget. Incident and world state remain application-owned.

components.title: Rules captain
responsibilities: Implements the same CaptainProvider.decide port.
Uses incident-local evidence without calling a model.
components.state: Mission duration setting; receives current public context on every decision.

components.title: Shared call budget
components.summary: One finite allowance across enabled model roles.
responsibilities: Consumes a call before an external request.
Captain and adversary also apply a per-call output-token limit; Jev has no documented equivalent.
components.state: CallBudget counters shared by Jev, captain and adversary.

components.title: Run log
components.summary: Persist ordinary and malicious activity as JSONL.
responsibilities: Records world initialization and transitions, decisions, public evidence and outcomes.
Synchronous EventSink receives defensive copies.
Start/event/end validation makes completed logs replayable.
components.state: Open log file, sequence and completion bookkeeping; persisted run records are the audit trail.

components.title: Evaluator
components.summary: Measure mission outcomes independently of AI claims.
responsibilities: Computes survival, resource use, incidents and model usage from facts.
Reports unavailable metrics instead of inventing values.
components.state: Pure calculation over snapshots and recorded events. No mutable service state.

components.title: Model API
responsibilities: TypeSafe SDK requests Jev judgments; OpenAI-compatible SDK requests captain/adversary tool actions.
Network failures become sanitized ProviderError results.
components.state: Remote provider state is outside this repository. The explorer never makes model requests.

connections.failure: No future turn leaves the incident open and unscheduled.

connections.label: CaptainContext

connections.failure: Provider failure schedules another review when time remains.

connections.failure: The caller retains authority over state.

connections.failure: The caller retains authority over state.

connections.failure: The caller retains authority over state.

connections.failure: Rejected actions leave the world unchanged.

connections.failure: The caller retains authority over state.

connections.failure: These facts are private and must not enter crew prompts.

connections.failure: The caller retains authority over state.

connections.failure: The caller retains authority over state.

connections.failure: The caller retains authority over state.

connections.failure: The caller retains authority over state.

connections.failure: The caller retains authority over state.

connections.failure: Invalid model output becomes ProviderError.

connections.description: Consume from the same shared object before an external request.
connections.failure: The caller retains authority over state.

connections.label: Call allowance
connections.description: Captain requests share the same finite budget.
connections.failure: The caller retains authority over state.

connections.label: MissionConfig
connections.description: The entry point calls run_mission with the selected configuration and injected providers.
connections.when: Once per run, before the first turn.
connections.failure: Invalid configuration is rejected before mission execution.

connections.label: TurnResult
connections.description: The mission loop receives the advanced state, public evidence, and private transition records from the world engine. It routes each to the appropriate projection or audit sink.

connections.description: The adversary adapter serializes current private state and bounded action choices into an OpenRouter request.
connections.when: An AI adversary is enabled and a request budget remains.
connections.failure: Provider failures are logged and do not authorize a disruption.

connections.label: Shared call budget
connections.description: The adversary consumes the same finite request allowance as the captain and Jev.
connections.failure: An exhausted allowance prevents further model calls.
